name: Tempo
summary: Agent platform that turns customer feedback, issues and requirements into reviewed pull requests.
description: Tempo uses AI agents to turn customer feedback, issues and product requirements into pull requests, while the team approves key decisions. It also tracks issues and documentation and runs tests locally. The Free plan includes 250 issues, 100 docs and 500 local tests per month; Pro costs $50 per month for one user plus $40 per extra user, with additional tests at $4.50 per thousand.

howToUse.description: Bring in customer feedback, issues, and product requirements. Tempo tracks those issues and the documentation.

howToUse.description: The agents prepare the pull requests, and the team approves the key decisions.
